-module(distribution_packet_probe).
-export([run/1]).

run(Output) ->
    put(output, Output),
    false = erlang:is_alive(),
    nonode@nohost = node(),
    true = register(net_kernel, self()),
    true = erlang:setnode(packet_local@localhost, 1),
    Owner = self(),
    {Controller, Monitor} = spawn_monitor(fun() -> controller(Owner) end),
    try
        Handle = receive {ready, Controller, H} -> H after 5000 -> error(controller_timeout) end,
        save("inputs.etf", term_to_binary({packet_remote@localhost, flags(), 1})),
        receive Notice = {dist_ctrlr, Controller, packet_remote@localhost, Controller} ->
            save("kernel-notice.etf", term_to_binary(Notice))
        after 5000 -> error(kernel_notice_timeout) end,
        Payload = {packet_payload, <<0, 128, 255>>, [a | binary_tail]},
        save("payload.etf", term_to_binary(Payload)),
        save("identities.etf", term_to_binary({Owner, Controller, node(), erlang:is_alive()})),
        Control = {2, '', self()},
        Packet = packet(Control, Payload),
        save("incoming-send-control.etf", term_to_binary(Control)),
        save("incoming-send.packet", Packet),
        Controller ! {input, Packet},
        receive {input_result, Result} -> save("incoming-send-result.etf", term_to_binary(Result))
        after 5000 -> error(input_result_timeout) end,
        receive Payload -> save("incoming-send-delivered.etf", term_to_binary(Payload))
        after 5000 -> error(send_delivery_timeout) end,
        true = register(packet_sink, self()),
        Registered = {6, self(), '', packet_sink},
        RegisteredPacket = packet(Registered, Payload),
        save("incoming-reg-send-control.etf", term_to_binary(Registered)),
        save("incoming-reg-send.packet", RegisteredPacket),
        Controller ! {input, RegisteredPacket},
        receive {input_result, RegisteredResult} -> save("incoming-reg-send-result.etf", term_to_binary(RegisteredResult))
        after 5000 -> error(input_result_timeout) end,
        receive Payload -> save("incoming-reg-send-delivered.etf", term_to_binary(Payload))
        after 5000 -> error(registered_delivery_timeout) end,
        {packet_sink, packet_remote@localhost} ! Payload,
        Controller ! drain,
        receive {output, Bytes} ->
            save("outgoing-reg-send.packet", Bytes),
            <<112, Terms/binary>> = Bytes,
            {OutgoingControl, Used} = binary_to_term(Terms, [used]),
            <<_:Used/binary, MessageBytes/binary>> = Terms,
            Payload = binary_to_term(MessageBytes),
            {6, Owner, '', packet_sink} = OutgoingControl,
            save("outgoing-reg-send-control.etf", term_to_binary(OutgoingControl))
        after 5000 -> error(output_timeout) end,
        save("stats.etf", term_to_binary(erlang:dist_get_stat(Handle))),
        save("stage", <<"complete">>),
        ok
    after
        Controller ! stop,
        receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Controller, Reason} ->
            save("cleanup-controller.etf", term_to_binary(Reason))
        after 5000 -> exit(Controller, kill),
                      receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Controller, Reason} ->
                          save("cleanup-controller.etf", term_to_binary({forced, Reason}))
                      after 5000 -> error(cleanup_timeout) end
        end
    end.

controller(Owner) ->
    Handle = erlang:setnode(packet_remote@localhost, self(), {flags(), 1}),
    ok = erlang:dist_ctrl_input_handler(Handle, self()),
    Owner ! {ready, self(), Handle},
    loop(Owner, Handle).

loop(Owner, Handle) ->
    receive
        {input, Bytes} ->
            Owner ! {input_result, erlang:dist_ctrl_put_data(Handle, Bytes)},
            loop(Owner, Handle);
        drain ->
            erlang:dist_ctrl_get_data_notification(Handle),
            receive dist_data -> ok after 5000 -> error(data_notice_timeout) end,
            Data = erlang:dist_ctrl_get_data(Handle),
            Owner ! {output, iolist_to_binary(Data)},
            loop(Owner, Handle);
        stop -> ok
    end.

packet(Control, Payload) ->
    <<112, (term_to_binary(Control))/binary, (term_to_binary(Payload))/binary>>.

flags() ->
    %% OTP-29.1.1 dist.h DFLAG_DIST_MANDATORY; no cache, fragments or sender flag.
    16#04 bor 16#10 bor 16#80 bor 16#100 bor 16#200 bor 16#400 bor
    16#800 bor 16#10000 bor 16#20000 bor 16#40000 bor 16#1000000 bor
    16#2000000 bor (16#04 bsl 32).

save(Name, Bytes) -> ok = file:write_file(filename:join(get(output), Name), Bytes).

-module(distribution_packet_probe).
-export([run/1]).

run(Output) ->
    put(output, Output),
    false = erlang:is_alive(),
    nonode@nohost = node(),
    true = register(net_kernel, self()),
    true = erlang:setnode(packet_local@localhost, 1),
    Owner = self(),
    Pending = erts_internal:new_connection(packet_remote@localhost),
    save("pending-handle.etf", term_to_binary(Pending)),
    {Controller, Monitor} = spawn_monitor(fun() -> controller(Owner) end),
    try
        Handle = receive
                     {ready, Controller, H} -> H;
                     {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Controller, Reason} ->
                         put(packet_ready_down, {observed, Reason}),
                         save("controller-ready-failure.etf", term_to_binary(Reason)),
                         error({controller_died_before_ready, Reason})
                 after 5000 -> error(controller_timeout) end,
        save("inputs.etf", term_to_binary({packet_remote@localhost, flags(), 1, Pending})),
        receive Notice = {dist_ctrlr, Controller, packet_remote@localhost, Controller} ->
            save("kernel-notice.etf", term_to_binary(Notice))
        after 5000 -> error(kernel_notice_timeout) end,
        Payload = {packet_payload, <<0, 128, 255>>, [a | binary_tail]},
        save("payload.etf", term_to_binary(Payload)),
        save("identities.etf", term_to_binary({Owner, Controller, node(), erlang:is_alive()})),
        Control = {2, '', self()},
        Packet = packet(Control, Payload),
        save("incoming-send-control.etf", term_to_binary(Control)),
        save("incoming-send.packet", Packet),
        Controller ! {input, Packet},
        receive {input_result, Result} -> save("incoming-send-result.etf", term_to_binary(Result))
        after 5000 -> error(input_result_timeout) end,
        receive Payload -> save("incoming-send-delivered.etf", term_to_binary(Payload))
        after 5000 -> error(send_delivery_timeout) end,
        true = register(packet_sink, self()),
        Registered = {6, self(), '', packet_sink},
        RegisteredPacket = packet(Registered, Payload),
        save("incoming-reg-send-control.etf", term_to_binary(Registered)),
        save("incoming-reg-send.packet", RegisteredPacket),
        Controller ! {input, RegisteredPacket},
        receive {input_result, RegisteredResult} -> save("incoming-reg-send-result.etf", term_to_binary(RegisteredResult))
        after 5000 -> error(input_result_timeout) end,
        receive Payload -> save("incoming-reg-send-delivered.etf", term_to_binary(Payload))
        after 5000 -> error(registered_delivery_timeout) end,
        {packet_sink, packet_remote@localhost} ! Payload,
        Controller ! drain,
        receive {output, Bytes} ->
            save("outgoing-reg-send.packet", Bytes),
            <<112, Terms/binary>> = Bytes,
            {OutgoingControl, Used} = binary_to_term(Terms, [used]),
            <<_:Used/binary, MessageBytes/binary>> = Terms,
            Payload = binary_to_term(MessageBytes),
            {6, Owner, '', packet_sink} = OutgoingControl,
            save("outgoing-reg-send-control.etf", term_to_binary(OutgoingControl))
        after 5000 -> error(output_timeout) end,
        save("stats.etf", term_to_binary(erlang:dist_get_stat(Handle))),
        save("stage", <<"complete">>),
        ok
    after
        cleanup_controller(Controller, Monitor)
    end.

cleanup_controller(Controller, Monitor) ->
    case erase(packet_ready_down) of
        {observed, Reason} ->
            save("cleanup-controller.etf", term_to_binary(Reason));
        undefined ->
            Controller ! stop,
            receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Controller, Reason} ->
                save("cleanup-controller.etf", term_to_binary(Reason))
            after 5000 -> exit(Controller, kill),
                          receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Controller, Reason} ->
                              save("cleanup-controller.etf", term_to_binary({forced, Reason}))
                          after 5000 -> error(cleanup_timeout) end
            end
    end.

controller(Owner) ->
    Handle = erlang:setnode(packet_remote@localhost, self(), {flags(), 1}),
    ok = erlang:dist_ctrl_input_handler(Handle, self()),
    Owner ! {ready, self(), Handle},
    loop(Owner, Handle).

loop(Owner, Handle) ->
    receive
        {input, Bytes} ->
            Owner ! {input_result, erlang:dist_ctrl_put_data(Handle, Bytes)},
            loop(Owner, Handle);
        drain ->
            erlang:dist_ctrl_get_data_notification(Handle),
            receive dist_data -> ok after 5000 -> error(data_notice_timeout) end,
            Data = erlang:dist_ctrl_get_data(Handle),
            Owner ! {output, iolist_to_binary(Data)},
            loop(Owner, Handle);
        stop -> ok
    end.

packet(Control, Payload) ->
    <<112, (term_to_binary(Control))/binary, (term_to_binary(Payload))/binary>>.

flags() ->
    %% OTP-29.1.1 dist.h DFLAG_DIST_MANDATORY; no cache, fragments or sender flag.
    16#04 bor 16#10 bor 16#80 bor 16#100 bor 16#200 bor 16#400 bor
    16#800 bor 16#10000 bor 16#20000 bor 16#40000 bor 16#1000000 bor
    16#2000000 bor (16#04 bsl 32).

save(Name, Bytes) -> ok = file:write_file(filename:join(get(output), Name), Bytes).

# Pinned distribution pass-through observations

Build the standalone collector and run it with three arguments: the source-built OTP root, a fresh output directory, and the source-build evidence JSON. The manual distribution-packet-contrasts workflow builds exactly OTP-29.1.1 at ad05823719d77c8faee87348ea39513d4e2f99c5 and attests OTP29/ERTS17.1/JIT before compiling the genuine probe.

One fresh VM registers a fixture kernel process, adopts a real process controller through setnode/3, designates the input handler, injects SEND and REG_SEND packets, receives the actual payloads, and captures outgoing REG_SEND bytes. It captures exact input control/payload ETFs, dynamic owner/controller/node identities, kernel notice and complete class/reason/stack on failure, with actual monitored controller cleanup. Networking, TCP, epmd, handshake, and SDK-derived expected outputs are absent. Statistics are native observations, not a claimed SDK counter mapping.

The source plan binds the probe and all seventeen required raw artifacts. Raw stdout/stderr/exit and bounded timeout/drain state accompany runtime, compile, disassembly and probe invocations. Capture completion is separate from semantic compatibility; neither collector compilation nor SDK packet tests prove original execution. Native outcomes require publishing and dispatching the exact commit, then independently verifying its artifacts against the unchanged source plan.

name: Pinned OTP distribution packet observations
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  fixtures:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json
      - name: Build standalone distribution packet observation tool
        id: packet-tool
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts
          dotnet build tools/Erlang.DistributionPacketContrasts -m:1 --disable-build-servers 2>&1 | tee artifacts/beam-fixture-tool-build.log
      - name: Build standalone mixed map observation tool
        id: mixed-tool
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts
          dotnet build tools/Erlang.MixedMapIdentityContrasts -m:1 --disable-build-servers 2>&1 | tee artifacts/mixed-map-tool-build.log
      - name: Build and attest the pinned development compiler
        id: pinned-build
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && (steps.packet-tool.outcome == 'success' || steps.mixed-tool.outcome == 'success') }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            echo "PINNED_BEAM_SOURCE_BEGIN $GITHUB_SHA"
            git clone --depth 1 --branch OTP-29.1.1 https://github.com/erlang/otp.git artifacts/beam-otp-source
            source_commit="$(git -C artifacts/beam-otp-source rev-parse HEAD)"
            test "$source_commit" = ad05823719d77c8faee87348ea39513d4e2f99c5
            echo "PINNED_BEAM_SOURCE_VERIFIED $source_commit"
            cd artifacts/beam-otp-source
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_CONFIGURE --without-javac --without-wx --without-odbc --without-debugger --without-observer --without-et'
            ./configure --prefix="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/beam-otp-oracle" --without-javac --without-wx --without-odbc --without-debugger --without-observer --without-et
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_MAKE -j2'
            make -j2
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_INSTALL'
            make install
            test "$(cat "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang/releases/29/OTP_VERSION")" = 29.1.1
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_INSTALL_VERIFIED 29.1.1'
          } 2>&1 | tee artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib
          root = pathlib.Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
          log = root / 'artifacts/beam-otp-build.log'
          evidence = {
              'SourceCommit': 'ad05823719d77c8faee87348ea39513d4e2f99c5',
              'SourceTag': 'OTP-29.1.1',
              'SourceBuildCompleted': True,
              'InstalledOtpRoot': str(root / 'artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang'),
              'SourceBuildLog': str(log),
              'SourceBuildLogSha256': hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper(),
              'HarnessCommit': os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],
              'RunId': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],
              'RunAttempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
              'Job': os.environ['GITHUB_JOB'],
              'RunnerOs': os.environ['RUNNER_OS'],
              'ConfigureOptions': ['--without-javac','--without-wx','--without-odbc','--without-debugger','--without-observer','--without-et'],
              'BuildArguments': ['make','-j2'],
              'InstallArguments': ['make','install']
          }
          (root / 'artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY
      - name: Capture actual process-controller SEND and REG_SEND in a fresh VM
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.packet-tool.outcome == 'success' && steps.pinned-build.outcome == 'success' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          dotnet run --project tools/Erlang.DistributionPacketContrasts --no-build -- artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang artifacts/distribution-packet artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
      - name: Capture one mixed map transition in a separate fresh VM
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.mixed-tool.outcome == 'success' && steps.pinned-build.outcome == 'success' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          dotnet run --project tools/Erlang.MixedMapIdentityContrasts --no-build -- artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang artifacts/mixed-map-identity artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pinned-distribution-packet
          path: |
            artifacts/distribution-packet
            artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
            artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
            artifacts/beam-fixture-tool-build.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pinned-mixed-map-identity
          path: |
            artifacts/mixed-map-identity
            artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
            artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
            artifacts/mixed-map-tool-build.log
